name: Monarch
description: Monarch lets agents read accounts, transactions, budgets, and cash flow in the user's Monarch account. Each user signs in to their own Monarch account through the browser.

prompts.text: How much did I spend on dining out last month?
Which budget categories am I over this month?
Summarize my income and expenses for the last three months.

apps.name: Monarch
apps.description: Accounts, transactions, budgets, and cash flow, over Monarch's MCP server with browser sign-in.
